title: Low-Budget Active Learning through Entropic Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.01199v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider low-budget active learning, which consists of selecting a limited number of points, the coreset, such that a model can be trained to high accuracy on the selection only. This problem is particularly relevant in contexts where labeling requires costly expert intervention, as in medical applications. We leverage features extracted from a pretrained self-supervised model to represent the data, and perform coreset selection directly in this feature space. In this paper, we use entropic optimal transport, specifically the Sinkhorn divergence, as the coreset selection criterion, which first allows us to get dimension-free sample complexity results, and second admits computationally efficient gradient evaluations. This opens the way to using gradient-based algorithms to rapidly compute solution candidates, further improved by a swap-based local search, with guarantees on the solution quality. translated_title: 基于熵正则最优传输的低预算主动学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究低预算主动学习问题，即选取数量有限的点（核心集，coreset），使得模型仅在该子集上训练即可达到较高精度。这一问题在标注需要昂贵专家干预的场景中尤为重要，例如医学应用。我们利用从预训练自监督模型中提取的特征来表示数据，并直接在该特征空间中进行核心集选择。在本文中，我们采用熵正则最优传输，具体即Sinkhorn散度，作为核心集选择准则，这首先使我们能够获得与维度无关的样本复杂度结果，其次支持计算高效的梯度评估。这为使用基于梯度的算法快速计算候选解开辟了道路，并通过基于交换的局部搜索进一步提升解的质量，且对解的质量提供了保证。我们在图像基准数据集和医学数据上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出以熵正则最优传输（Sinkhorn散度）作为核心集选择准则，在预训练自监督模型的特征空间中进行低预算主动学习的样本选择，兼具与维度无关的样本复杂度理论保证和计算高效性，可通过基于梯度的算法结合交换式局部搜索快速求解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using entropic optimal transport (Sinkhorn divergence) as a coreset selection criterion for low-budget active learning in the feature space of pretrained self-supervised models, providing dimension-free sample complexity guarantees and computational efficiency, enabling rapid gradient-based solutions further improved by swap-based local search with quality guarantees.
